newsitem.title: USA: S.Carolina police break narcotics rings.
newsitem.headline: S.Carolina police break narcotics rings.

text.p: Law enforcement officials have seized about $1.5 million in cash as well as cars, boats and weapons in one of South Carolina's biggest drug busts, police said Wednesday.
A state grand jury indicted 41 people in connection with what authorities say are four drug rings operating in South Carolina, Florida, Texas and New York.

By Wednesday, 25 suspects had been arrested. Authorities also confiscated 22 pounds (10 kg) of cocaine and a cache of weapons, including a machinegun, assault rifles and handguns. Eleven vehicles were seized.
Called "Operation Cueball" because some of the suspects played pool, the undercover operation began in February.
